name: ghalint

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/**/*.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/**/*.yaml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  setup:
    name: Setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      has_changes: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.has_changes }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Filter changes
        id: filter
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        with:
          filters: |
            has_changes:
              - '.github/workflows/**/*.yml'
              - '.github/workflows/**/*.yaml'

  ghalint:
    name: ghalint
    needs: setup
    if: needs.setup.outputs.has_changes == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Download ghalint
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://github.com/suzuki-shunsuke/ghalint/releases/download/v1.5.1/ghalint_1.5.1_linux_amd64.tar.gz | tar xz
          chmod +x ghalint
          mv ghalint /usr/local/bin/

      - name: Run ghalint
        run: ghalint .github/workflows
